description: Pulse Wave 6.1.12 — Smart Playlist Resume, Spotify Library Cards, Floating Vinyl Mini-Player, Interactive Widget Launcher, Admin Reports Purge & In-App Updater Fix.

changelog.title: Smart Playback & Queue Memory
items: Smart Playlist Resume: When you stop playback and leave the app, PulseWave automatically remembers the exact song index for that playlist so you never get stuck listening to the first 10-15 tracks on repeat.
Floating Vinyl Mini-Player: Redesigned fluid mini-player with authentic vinyl disc styling and smooth expanded player animations.
Media Notification Icon: Restored crisp, full-color application icon in media notification bar.

changelog.title: Library & Spotify Sync
items: Spotify-Style Library Cards: High-definition 2-column rounded card grid with artwork collage preview and download status badges.
Bidirectional Spotify Sync: Sync tracks both ways between PulseWave and Spotify with smart deduplication and ISRC matching.

changelog.title: Home Screen Widget & Admin Controls
items: Interactive Playlist Launcher Widget: Direct 1-tap playback controls right from your Android home screen.
Admin Panel Error Purge: Dedicated button in Admin Mode to instantly clear and purge stale error reports from Supabase.

changelog.title: Updater & Release Improvements
items: In-App Updater Logic Fix: Resolved version comparison glitch where newer installations were prompted to download older versions.
Automated Desktop Records: Seamless local archiving of release APKs directly to your Desktop.
